answer: Trust the check, not the claimant: Registered mortar mixer mortar file with mortar mixers endorsement is the check, and it reads 3-year training, 230 supervised keepings, safety exam, annual re-assessment. A hundred would-be clones face a hundred separate bills: 95 POA and 14 minutes each, 74005 POA and 10906 minutes in all. A farm can print a crystal, it can fake a tide, but it cannot backdate a pearl without the archive noticing. One check, one price, one open book: the farm cannot afford the book.
